state.background: Review the new research-only Plan39 two-plus-share backtest implemented in scripts/plan39/two-plus-share-backtest.mjs, with output in results/plan39/two-plus-share-backtest/summary.json and annual-backtest.csv and provenance in data/source/cti-size-composition/two-plus-share-backtest/source-trace.json. Scope is a test of whether multiplying the basic CTI education share by all-households two-plus share improves prediction after 2017 calibration. Exclude 2017 from validation; validate 2018–2025 only. This does not modify or feed production estimator, loader, publication gates, or quarterly calculations. Independent read-only review found calculations and source joins consistent.
acceptanceCriteria: Use pB_t=B_edu/B_total and pi2plus_t=1-pi1_t. Calibrate q2017=(Aedu17/Atotal17)/(Bedu17/Btotal17), then K=q2017/pi2plus17. Compare baseline pAhat_t=pB_t*q2017 with proposed pAhat_t=pB_t*pi2plus_t*K.
2017 is calibration/anchor only; validation is all eight years 2018–2025, with coverage 8/8 and no omitted validation years.

CTI inputs come from official 2025-base raw XLSX files: basic B statInfId 000040499069 and adjusted A statInfId 000040499087, sheet 総・年. The source trace records exact annual rows and I/J/R year/total/education cells, source hashes and raw values for every 2017–2025 year.

Annual January setai-n files provide exact national counts from column E, sheet/year-specific household-distribution table, size bins 1,2,3,4,5+, published denominator 1,000,000. pi2plus is computed as one minus single-household share. Published rounding may make size-bin shares total 999,999 or 1,000,001 parts; the script retains published counts without renormalizing.

Calibration K=1.5442044275. On validation 2018–2025, anchor-only MAE/RMSE/bias are 0.0671437/0.0842242/+0.0616872 percentage points; proposed pi2plus model metrics are 0.1148997/0.1437164/-0.0904172 percentage points. Thus adding pi2plus worsened absolute prediction errors in this backtest; report this outcome as a research result, not a successful improvement claim.

Caveats: each setai-n file is published as the special tabulation for that year's January Household Survey; the monthly correction uses trailing-12-month LFS household-size shares, making the January snapshots annual proxies rather than calendar-year averages. Household Survey redesigned in 2018. LFS population benchmark changed to 2015 Census estimates beginning January 2017 and 2020 Census estimates beginning January 2022; pooled metrics include these discontinuity years.
The backtest is research-only with no production connection. Script regeneration completed, git diff --check passed, and no tests were run.
verification: Inspected current script, result summary and annual table, and source trace with CTI raw rows/cells and LFS national extraction evidence.
Summary reports eight complete validation years and the stated calibration and model metrics.
Independent read-only review found calculations and source joins consistent.
git diff --check passed. No tests run.
knownConstraints: The LFS January snapshot is a proxy for the preceding/trailing 12-month correction distribution, not a calendar-year average.
Household Survey redesign and LFS benchmark changes overlap the validation period; pooled metrics include discontinuity years.
The proposed model worsens MAE and RMSE versus the anchor-only baseline on the supplied 2018–2025 validation data.
This artifact is research-only and has no production estimator, loader, gate, or quarterly consumer.
state.outputRequirement: Choose one listed choice. For a reason choice, provide a case-specific finding, affected artifact or criterion, observed evidence, and either concrete proposed fix or exact additional evidence needed. Do not invent details.

implementation.instructions: Does the supplied evidence support accepting this research-only backtest as a faithful, clearly caveated test of the stated formula and validation design, including an honest report when the proposed model performs worse? Return a probability distribution over the listed choices.

criteria.missing_prerequisites_info: A specific source datum or series definition needed for this backtest is missing; state exactly what is needed.
